Title: Introduction to N-Dimensional Space and Mathematical Concepts
Summary: This chapter introduces the concept of N-dimensional space, illustrating it with a diagram and explaining mathematical concepts such as softmax, logit, and the maximum of vectors. It also explores the relationship between these concepts and their applications in machine learning. This chapter provides an overview of various neural network architectures, including MLP, CNN, RNN, LSTM, and Transformer. It visually represents these architectures and highlights their specific applications in different domains.
